description: This file defines an API endpoint for user authentication in a web application. It handles login requests, interacts with ASP.NET Core Identity's SignInManager, and issues tokens upon successful login.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint class that handles user authentication requests, validates credentials, and returns an authentication response including a token if successful.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the POST authentication request, performs user sign-in, and constructs the response with authentication status and token.
